title: Tickstopper
description: A simple mod that stops ticks on the server when there are no players on it.
body:
I created this mod because I needed one like this. It is a simple mod that stops time on the server, i.e. Minecraft ticks. It works very simply:
- there is at least one person, time flows normally
- there is no person, time stops

I decided to share it and I think it will be useful to others as well, and I personally used it with the seasons mod :)
